system.description:
When you use Coordinated Strike! you can forgo your attack. When you do so, your ally has advantage and deals bonus damage equal to your Combat Die.

[A] With Nim+ class automation on, using Coordinated Strike asks whether you forgo your attack: the ally's attack then has advantage and adds a roll of your Combat Die (not spent), and your free attack is taken back (Undo card).

[M] Without Nim+, skip your attack; the ally rolls with advantage and adds a roll of your Combat Die by hand.
